text: This activity can be really fun to do in your local library. You could even borrow the books you choose to read at home! You can also do the activity with a selection of children's books at home.

Choose your books:

Ask your child to choose five books they might like to read.

Let them spend lots of time looking and choosing - browsing is really important because it gives children a chance to think about the choices they are making and develop their own tastes and interests.

Look at the books:

  1. When they have chosen about five books, sit down and look at the covers of the books together.
  2. Ask your child why they chose these five. Encourage them to explain giving several reasons.
  3. Read the titles together.
  4. Use the titles to help you choose which book you want to read first.
  5. Read the book to your child. Let them read it to you if they want to!
  6. Talk together about the book.
  7. Was it what you were expecting from the title and the cover?


If you want, you could repeat this with the other books they have chosen.

If you are in the library, let your child choose which book (or books) they would like to borrow and take home.
